title: Phylogeny of the tribe Cardueae (Compositae) with emphasis on the subtribe Carduinae: an analysis based on ITS sequence data
sampling: broad genus-level Cardueae sampling with emphasis on Carduinae
principal_inference: Provided the foundational ITS hypothesis of Carduinae generic affinities and explicitly tested the relationship of Carduinae to Centaureinae.
known_limit: one linked multicopy nuclear-ribosomal region; recent radiations and reticulation unresolved
EAzami_relevance: essential pre-2002 molecular baseline and public alignment for historical-topology sensitivity
data_or_access: Berlin electronic supplement with data matrix

title: On the phylogeny of the subtribe Carduinae (tribe Cardueae, Compositae)
markers_or_loci: 52 morphological and anatomical characters coded as 66 transitions
sampling: 37 ingroup and three outgroup genus-level taxa
principal_inference: Recovered major morphological groups including the Carduus-Cirsium group and identified fruit pappus testa corolla and achene characters informative at genus level.
known_limit: genus-level morphology only; 48 equally parsimonious trees; no sequence evidence
EAzami_relevance: documents the morphological hypotheses and character systems later tested by molecular phylogenetics
data_or_access: Englera 21 open publisher abstract and JSTOR record

title: From Pleistocene Corridors to Isolated Peaks and Back: Biogeography of Afrocarduus (Compositae) in the Afromontane Archipelago
markers_or_loci: 489 nuclear loci; ancestral-range and diversification analyses
sampling: comprehensive Afrocarduus geographic and taxonomic sampling
principal_inference: Inferred a late-Miocene Afromontane origin around 10.7 Ma and major early-Pleistocene diversification around 2.3 Ma with mostly neighbouring-massif dispersal plus rare long-distance events.
known_limit: segregate African genus rather than East Asian Cirsium; population gene flow not the main target
EAzami_relevance: current comparative example of mountain radiation under the same Carduus-Cirsium phylogenomic framework
data_or_access: open Journal of Biogeography article and underlying public reads

title: Hidden lineages in the African Sky Islands: A taxonomic reevaluation of Afrocarduus (Compositae)
sampling: Afrocarduus sampled across Ethiopian and East African mountain systems
principal_inference: Recovered 16 evolutionary lineages; expanded recognized diversity from eight to 18 species; found two independent origins of the stemless habit and paraphyly plausibly caused by ILS or hybridization.
known_limit: outside East Asia and within a segregate genus; some species lacked molecular data
EAzami_relevance: direct current demonstration that conspicuous growth forms can evolve repeatedly and that young thistle radiations require integrative delimitation and discordance analysis
data_or_access: open Journal of Systematics and Evolution article

title: Comparative chloroplast genomics of Cardueae (Carduoideae, Asteraceae): the first tribe-wide analysis
markers_or_loci: complete chloroplast genomes; ML and Bayesian phylogenies; comparative genomics
sampling: 72 species representing 51 genera and all 12 Cardueae subtribes
principal_inference: Produced the most comprehensive Cardueae plastome framework to date; supported nine subtribes but recovered Saussureinae and Onopordinae as polyphyletic and exposed cytonuclear discordance.
known_limit: one nonrecombining maternal genome; only one Cirsium tip in the broad tree; cannot replace nuclear species trees
EAzami_relevance: major current maternal-history resource and explicit evidence that nuclear and plastid histories must be modelled separately
data_or_access: open BMC Plant Biology article with alignments trees scripts and accessions in supplements
